# statement.work

> statement.work is a bank statement converter. It reads bank statements (PDF exports, scanned copies and phone photos, from any bank and in any layout) and turns every transaction into clean CSV, Excel or JSON. It is built for accountants, bookkeepers and small businesses, and is currently in early access with a waitlist.

## What it does

- Converts bank statement PDFs to Excel and CSV (and JSON).
- Reads scanned statements and phone photos (bank statement OCR), not only PDFs with selectable text.
- Works across banks and layouts without a template mapped in advance.
- Extracts date, description, amount and running balance for every line, in one consistent format.
- Handles several statements in one upload.
- Categorizes transactions automatically (for example payroll, rent, subscriptions).
- Flags anomalies: duplicate charges, fee spikes and unusual transactions.
- Handles statements in different currencies.
- Answers plain-language questions about your statements, such as "What did we spend on software in Q2?"

## Who it's for

Accountants, bookkeepers and small businesses who spend time turning bank statements into spreadsheets for bookkeeping, month-end close or tax prep.

## Data handling

- Statements are encrypted in transit and at rest.
- Source files are deleted after processing, on a retention window the user controls.
- Customer financial data is never used to train or fine-tune AI models.

## Status

statement.work is in early access. Accountants, bookkeepers and small businesses can join the waitlist at https://statement.work/#early-access.
